questions.question: Zerubbabel and the family heads gladly accepted their enemies' offer to help build the temple in Jerusalem. True or false?
What did the people of the land try to do to the Jews who were working on God's temple?

answers.text: Tax them for using the land

questions.question: In a letter to King Artaxerxes, enemies of the Jews warned that if Jerusalem was rebuilt, what would the Jews stop paying?
Officials who wrote King Artaxerxes against the Jews rebuilding Jerusalem received his reply. What did they do after it was read?

answers.text: Went to Jerusalem and stopped the work by force
Waited a whole year and then sent word
Wrote the king back asking for details
